scripts.fresh: npm run clean && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.generate-secret:
node -e "const crypto = require('crypto'); const fs = require('fs'); const secret = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('base64'); const envPath = '.env.local'; let content = ''; try { content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8'); } catch(e) {} const lines = content.split('
').filter(l => !l.startsWith('AUTH_SECRET=')); lines.push('AUTH_SECRET=' + secret); fs.writeFileSync(envPath, lines.join('
').trim() + '
'); console.log('✓ AUTH_SECRET generated and saved to .env.local');"
